answer: Neighborhood Rank Inheritance.** Each agent's discovery reach is capped by the median connectivity of its declared peers, measured on the live routing graph. A new node arriving from a distant voyage of relays inherits a low ceiling until genuine two-hop neighbors attach. To fake a summit of visibility, an attacker must seed a full connected subgraph of distinct live hosts and sustain real traffic through each edge; isolated clusters stay hollow and unranked. Cost: one maintained host per 25 ranks gained.
